title: Somatic Likelihood Tiering (SLT): an SNV-calibrated interpretable post-calling triage protocol for tumor-only whole-exome variant review
description: Somatic Likelihood Tiering (SLT) is a deterministic, callability-aware post-calling triage protocol for tumor-only whole-exome variant review. Version 2.1.0 implements the R1 gnomAD three-state Layer 2 contract, annotation-only six-cell routing, PureCN posterior preflight checks, and CHIP safety flagging used in the revised BIB submission package.
